diagrams.class_diagram:
classDiagram
    class Case {
        -String caseId
        -String status
        -DateTime registrationDate
        -String description
        -String title
        -DateTime createdAt
        -DateTime updatedAt
        -DateTime createdDate
        -DateTime lastAccessed
        +register()
        +updateStatus()
        +assignOfficer()
    }
    class Suspect {
        -String suspectId
        -String name
        -String identificationNumber
        -Integer age
        -String gender
        -String description
        +addToCase()
        +updateDetails()
    }
    class Property {
        -String propertyId
        -String description
        -Decimal value
        -String name
        +associateWithCase()
        +updateValue()
    }
    class Document {
        -String documentId
        -String title
        -Binary content
        -String type
        +upload()
        +download()
        +associateWithCase()
    }
    class AuditTrail {
        -String auditId
        -String action
        -DateTime timestamp
        -String userId
        -String entityType
        -String entityId
        +logAction()
        +exportRecords()
    }
    class UserProfile {
        -String userId
        -String role
        -Object preferences
        -Object uiPreferences
        -String language
        -String username
        +updateProfile()
        +setPreferences()
    }
    class Complaint {
        -String complaintId
        -String description
        -String status
        -String title
        +submit()
        +updateStatus()
    }
    class SearchResult {
        -String searchId
        -String query
        -Integer resultCount
        -String resultId
        -List items
        -String queryId
        -List results
        +executeSearch()
        +filterResults()
    }
    Case "1" --> "*" Suspect : contains
    Case "1" --> "*" Property : contains
    Case "1" --> "*" Document : contains
    Case "1" --> "*" AuditTrail : generates
    Case "1" --> "*" UserProfile : assigned_to
    UserProfile "1" --> "*" Case : assigned_to
    Complaint "1" --> "1" Case : refers_to
    Complaint "1" --> "1" UserProfile : submitted_by
    SearchResult "*" --> "*" Case : references
    SearchResult "1" --> "1" UserProfile : generated_for
    UserProfile "1" --> "*" AuditTrail : generates
